semantics.kind: pure combinational Moore state transition and output logic
semantics.timing: Outputs follow current inputs combinationally after settling; no clock or cycle latency.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.legal_inputs: All eight binary state/input combinations are legal. X/Z behavior is unspecified.

numeric.representation: Unsigned two-bit state encodings and one-bit boolean input/output.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, truncation, saturation, or overflow.

verification.oracle: Independent explicit lookup of the original eight transition-table entries and four Moore outputs.
verification.coverage: Exhaustively apply all eight combinations in ascending and descending order; compare both outputs after settling and repeat to check history independence.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, finite compile and simulation timeouts.
verification.static_review: Check exact ports, complete combinational assignments, widths, no sequential logic and no simulation-only DUT constructs.
